records.part: Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) Radio system

records.part: High gain antenna array with built in Wave Relay form factor for mesh networking
records.reason: These features are proprietary to the MPU5 and are protected under Persistent Systems' intellectual property. No other product on the market integrates such comprehensive functionality into a single device.

records.part: LTE/5G Gateway multiband cellular gateway integrating LTE and 5G connectivity into Wave Relay MANET
records.reason: The PT5 integrates natively with the MPU5 ecosystem and Wave Relay firmware with no third-party adapters required.
